KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. pana
   B. zito
   C. nene
   D. fupi

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.

3. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.

4. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Anga.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Anga.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.

5. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.

6. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mato
   B. mitoto
   C. watoto
   D. kitoto

7. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.

8. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.
   B. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.
   D. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.

9. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Hili na Haya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Nambari 11-50 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
